answer: Require each identity to grow a vine of verifiable work: a sequential lineage where every task is derived from the previous answer's hash, so clones cannot copy or pool effort. A newcomer may wander through public tasks, but only work tied to its own lineage counts toward trust, and a haven of full rights opens only after many distinct, peer-checked milestones. Forging one fake means doing the whole chain alone; forging a thousand means a thousand chains.
